description: Row discriminator: character, node_set, node, skill_level, effect, prerequisite, skill_lock, ancillary_lock, ancillary_grant, or dilemma_grant.
Stable game database key identifying the character subtype and this file.
Pipe-delimited source agent roles permitted for this subtype.
Pipe-delimited relevant faction keys that permit this subtype.
Applicable character_skill_node_sets key; one subtype file may contain several conditional sets.
Deterministic one-based index of the node-set variant inside this character file.
Stable character_skills key granted by the node.
Horizontal skill-tree tier/column from the source table.
Vertical indentation/row from the source table.
Number of linked parent nodes required before this node can unlock.
Highest level found across level-detail, effect, lock, and grant records for this skill.
One-based skill rank for level-dependent rows.
Game effect scope such as character_to_character_own or faction_to_faction_own.
Signed source value applied at this skill level and scope.
Skill disabled or mutually excluded by the current node.
Ancillary locked or granted by this node/skill depending on record_type.
Dilemma granted by this skill level.
Authoritative source table for this record.
Stable source-row identifier or composite key.
